scope: internal experimental targets; no consumer SLA or capacity promise
ordinary_inputs: same fixed 40 ordinary images and order; input hash recorded per run; no substitution after seeing results

reference_mu.source: minimum successful completion throughput across 3 valid independent saturation windows
reference_mu.validity: capture fingerprints and source proofs; drift invalidates reference

classes.interpretation: 1.0 is near-capacity diagnostic, not an overload guarantee; a point without a full queue does not prove queue-full behavior

common.generator_late_or_unsent: INCONCLUSIVE_GENERATOR; do not lower actual arrivals silently
common.drain_clock: stop new submissions to all accepted tasks terminal; downloads measured separately
common.early_guard_stop: preserve failure and inspect accepted intents; no automatic replay/resume

measurement.queue_wait: database task created_at to attempt started_at; accepted tasks only
measurement.end_to_end: report submission, queue, execution/result commit observation, polling and download separately; updated_at alone is not durable completion or client latency proof
measurement.empty_accepted_set: cannot pass latency on an empty sample

selection.rule: smallest tested queue satisfying reserve, all scenario-specific budgets and correctness; confirm normals 3 independent times before final T4 gate
selection.no_eligible_candidate: stop with no recommendation; preserve original failed run; revise policy only as a new explicit version before retest

prerequisites: bind new profile and proofs without accepting old-profile stage results
implement versioned policy validation and classification before mutations
independent tests for thresholds and mixed profiles
revalidate candidate tuple and per-tuple conservative mu on new framework
freeze policy JSON SHA256 in every run; record all point outcomes including rejected candidates
not_in_scope: write lock enhancement or new monitoring
